CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Products data export can be generated for ProductsUp import without manual data patching.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Trigger the standard feed export run in the acceptance flow and capture the produced output file for a representative catalog slice. Validate that core product records are present and parseable by the business-facing import validation path.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
A feed file is generated successfully.
Core product records required for affiliate ingestion are present.
No manual data repair is required before import validation.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Inventory changes propagate into the generated feed in line with expected update cadence.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Choose at least one SKU with a known stock-state change and run a new feed export after the update window. Compare inventory fields in consecutive feed outputs and confirm the latest state appears in the newer export.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Updated stock values appear in the subsequent feed export.
No stale inventory value remains for the validated SKU after the refresh window.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Promotion-related pricing or flags are represented consistently for downstream channel consumption.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select products with and without promotions, generate the feed, and compare promotion-related fields across both sets. Confirm promoted products expose expected promotional indicators while non-promoted products keep baseline values.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Promoted products include expected promotional indicators in the feed.
Non-promoted products keep baseline values without false promotion flags.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Feed flow remains usable for both NAP and MRP business contexts.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Validate one representative product sample for NAP and one for MRP through the same export and downstream verification routine. Confirm each sample is present with expected core attributes in its respective business context.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
NAP sample data is present and consistent in downstream validation.
MRP sample data is present and consistent in downstream validation.
No cross-brand data omission is observed in the validated sample.
